note: Definitions for a future runner; no collectors, fixtures, lab resources, or tests have been provisioned or executed.

cases.title: Synthetic intake
cases.action: seed -> FastAPI -> PostgreSQL
cases.oracle: One seeded record persists; source and object match
cases.interpretation_rule: Known seed must be linked to verified stored record

cases.title: Authorized read
cases.action: approved user reads seeded record
cases.oracle: Actor/role/object/operation attributed
cases.interpretation_rule: Report unknown row attribution unless row-level visibility exists

cases.title: Unauthorized access deny
cases.action: test-role attempts prohibited read
cases.oracle: Read is denied and denial recorded
cases.interpretation_rule: Fail when read returns protected seed; no copied payload

cases.title: Mutation lineage
cases.action: update and delete a synthetic record
cases.oracle: Before/after state fingerprints and lifecycle event
cases.interpretation_rule: Inconclusive when missing mutation event

cases.title: ETL removes marker
cases.action: ETL derives new output without marker
cases.oracle: Explicit derived-from relation supported by ETL metadata
cases.interpretation_rule: No guesswork from similar content

cases.title: Backup and restore
cases.action: snapshot followed by isolated restore
cases.observer: Backup job events + readback in restored copy
cases.oracle: Tracer recovered and matched against original fingerprint
cases.interpretation_rule: Job success without restored tracer must not pass

cases.title: Archive retention
cases.action: archive synthetic object; test retrieval and deletion
cases.oracle: Retention, location, retrieval and deletion states recorded
cases.fault_injection: Archive not retrievable at required date
cases.interpretation_rule: Do not claim record-level archive if only snapshot metadata exists

cases.title: Forbidden test export
cases.action: send seeded object to prohibited local sink
cases.observer: Application and network flow + storage telemetry
cases.oracle: Observed prohibited destination, policy-linked finding
cases.interpretation_rule: Finding with coverage caveat; never transmit outside test network

cases.title: AI-agent data handling
cases.action: agent retrieves seed and invokes instrumented tool
cases.observer: Agent spans + retrieval logs + tool call logs
cases.oracle: Identity, retrieval reference, destination and policy status correlated
cases.fault_injection: Agent strips marker in generated text
cases.interpretation_rule: Attribute only supported retrieval/tool lineage; semantic effect is unknown

cases.title: Sensor outage
cases.action: stop collector during seeded operation
cases.oracle: Coverage gap; outcome inconclusive not passed
cases.interpretation_rule: Graceful replay and deterministic deduplication

cases.title: Async cloud propagation
cases.action: API Gateway/Lambda -> SQS -> S3 -> Lambda transform
cases.observer: OTel spans + SQS IDs + S3 data events
cases.oracle: Async parent-child provenance with retries captured
cases.interpretation_rule: No unsupported end-to-end links

cases.title: Object access authorization
cases.action: approved and forbidden principals request S3 synthetic object
cases.observer: IAM test requests + S3 data events
cases.oracle: Allowed access recorded; denied access rejected
cases.interpretation_rule: Explicitly identify missing object-level telemetry

cases.title: Backup recovery
cases.action: backup S3/RDS in sandbox and restore isolated copy
cases.oracle: Seed actually recovered and verified
cases.interpretation_rule: Backup job completion alone is not proof

cases.title: Encrypted storage
cases.action: KMS-encrypted test object processed through authorized path
cases.oracle: Data movement verified without plaintext packet inspection
cases.interpretation_rule: Denied decryption captured, no artificial marker recovery

cases.title: Telemetry failure
cases.action: late, missing, or disabled CloudTrail S3 data events
cases.oracle: Incomplete coverage recorded with latency caveat
cases.interpretation_rule: Never infer event absence equals no access

cases.title: Async cloud propagation
cases.action: Functions -> Service Bus -> Blob -> Function
cases.observer: App spans + Service Bus IDs + diagnostic logs
cases.oracle: Correlated processing through retries
cases.interpretation_rule: Dead-letter/unknown state evidence

cases.title: Blob authorization
cases.action: managed identities with allowed/denied blob access
cases.oracle: Denied principal cannot retrieve seed
cases.interpretation_rule: Unauthorized read is a finding and credential scrubbed

cases.title: Restore verification
cases.action: snapshot/backup restore to isolated test container
cases.oracle: Tracer recovered and fingerprint compared
cases.interpretation_rule: No pass on backup metadata only

cases.title: Data residency boundary
cases.action: copy synthetic blob between allowed and prohibited test regions
cases.oracle: Unexpected region transfer detected
cases.fault_injection: Create test replica in prohibited synthetic-policy region
cases.interpretation_rule: Ensure region use is lawful and within sandbox boundary

cases.title: Diagnostics gap
cases.action: turn off or delay Storage diagnostic pipeline
cases.oracle: Inconclusive result and explicit missing-source reason
cases.interpretation_rule: Never treat no events as negative evidence
